_meta.description: Mapping from pre-trained YOLO waste detection classes to ReWA.AI canonical bins and candidate labels for CLIP refinement.

battery.guidance_note: Handle with care; do not crush or puncture. Deposit in designated E-waste/Hazardous bin.

biological.guidance_note: Wet/organic waste for composting or green municipal bin.

brown-glass.guidance_note: Rinse clean, drain completely, and deposit gently in Glass bin.

cardboard.guidance_note: Flatten boxes and keep dry. Place in Paper / Dry Waste bin.

clothes.guidance_note: Textiles do not go in standard recycling bins. Donate usable clothing or drop off at specialized fabric collection points.

green-glass.guidance_note: Rinse clean, remove caps, and place in Glass bin.

metal.guidance_note: Rinse cans and tins clean. Aerosols or paint cans require hazardous handling.

paper.guidance_note: Keep clean and dry. Oily or wet paper cannot be recycled.

plastic.guidance_note: Rinse clean and dry. Rigid plastics go in standard plastic recycling; soft plastics to dry collection.

shoes.guidance_note: Footwear is composite material. Donate if wearable or deposit at specialized shoe recycling drop-offs.

trash.guidance_note: Non-recyclable sanitary or reject waste. Dispose in general landfill / red/black bin.

white-glass.guidance_note: Rinse clean, remove metal or plastic lids, and place in Glass bin.
